description: This file contains utility functions, constants, and context managers related to quantization in PyTorch, specifically for testing and internal checks in quantized tensor and module handling within the PyTorch testing suite.

methods.name: _conv_output_shape(input_size, kernel_size, padding, stride, dilation, output_padding=0)
methods.description: Computes the output shape of a convolution operation based on input parameters such as input size, kernel size, padding, stride, dilation, and output padding.

methods.name: _quantize(x, scale, zero_point, qmin=None, qmax=None, dtype=np.uint8)
methods.description: Quantizes a numpy array based on provided scale, zero point, and quantization range.

methods.name: _dequantize(qx, scale, zero_point)
methods.description: Dequantizes a numpy array using provided scale and zero point.

methods.name: _requantize(x, multiplier, zero_point, qmin=0, qmax=255, qtype=np.uint8)
methods.description: Requantizes an intermediate numpy array back to a specified qtype, typically after some operation.

methods.name: _calculate_dynamic_qparams(X, dtype, reduce_range=False, qscheme=torch.per_tensor_affine)
methods.description: Calculates dynamic quantization parameters (scale and zero point) based on the min/max of a tensor, supporting symmetric and affine schemes.

methods.name: _calculate_dynamic_per_channel_qparams(X, dtype)
methods.description: Calculates per-channel dynamic quantization parameters based on min/max per channel.

methods.name: _snr(x, x_hat)
methods.description: Calculates the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) in dB between two tensors or nested structures of tensors.

methods.name: override_quantized_engine(qengine)
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily override the quantized engine in torch.backends.quantized.

methods.name: override_cpu_allocator_for_qnnpack(qengine_is_qnnpack)
methods.description: Context manager to set or unset the default CPU allocator when using QNNPACK.

methods.name: override_qengines(qfunction)
methods.description: Decorator to run a test function with all supported quantized backends.

methods.name: qengine_is_fbgemm()
methods.description: Checks if the current quantized engine is 'fbgemm'.

methods.name: qengine_is_qnnpack()
methods.description: Checks if the current quantized engine is 'qnnpack'.

methods.name: qengine_is_onednn()
methods.description: Checks if the current quantized engine is 'onednn'.

methods.name: qengine_is_x86()
methods.description: Checks if the current quantized engine is 'x86'.

methods.name: _permute_to_axis_zero(X, axis)
methods.description: Permutes a tensor to bring a specified axis to the first position.

methods.name: _fake_quantize_per_channel_affine_reference(X, per_channel_scale, per_channel_zero_point, axis, quant_min, quant_max)
methods.description: Reference implementation for fake quantization per channel with affine parameters.

methods.name: _fake_quantize_per_channel_affine_grad_reference(dY, X, per_channel_scale, per_channel_zero_point, axis, quant_min, quant_max)
methods.description: Reference implementation for gradient of fake quantization per channel with affine parameters.

methods.name: to_tensor(X, device)
methods.description: Converts an input to a tensor on a specified device, cloning if necessary.

methods.name: int _n_ones(n: int)
methods.description: Returns the number of 1 bits in an integer, e.g., (1 << n) - 1.

methods.name: ceil_div(a, b)
methods.description: Performs ceiling division of two integers.

methods.name: torch.Tensor from_blocked(input, input_scales, blocksize)
methods.description: De-swaizzles and reshapes input tensor from a blocked format used by NVIDIA hardware into a regular tensor.

methods.name: from_blocked_format(x_mxfp8, scales_unswizzled, blocksize=32)
methods.description: Converts a blocked format tensor back into floating point representation, applying de-swaizzling and scale scaling.

methods.name: torch.Tensor to_blocked(input_matrix)
methods.description: Rearranges a tensor into a blocked format with a specific pattern for hardware acceleration.

methods.name: down_size(size)
methods.description: Halves the last dimension of a size tuple, asserting it's even.

methods.name: torch.Tensor pack_uint4(uint8_data)
methods.description: Packs two 4-bit unsigned integers into a single uint8 value.

methods.name: _bfloat16_to_float4_e2m1fn_x2(x)
methods.description: Converts a bfloat16 tensor to a custom 4-bit float format with 2 exponent bits and 1 mantissa bit.

methods.name: to_mxfp( data_hp: torch.Tensor, block_size: int = 32, format: str = "mxfp8", )
methods.description: Converts a tensor to a specific block-structured floating point format such as mxfp8 or mxfp4, involving scaling, exponent calculation, and reshaping.

methods.name: generate_jagged_offs(E, M, multiple_of=16, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
methods.description: Generates sorted tensor of length E, with values divisible by 'multiple_of', from 0 to M, useful for data permutations in benchmarks.

methods.name: Tensor _f32_to_floatx_unpacked(x: Tensor, ebits: int, mbits: int)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: Tensor _floatx_unpacked_to_f32(x: Tensor, ebits: int, mbits: int)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: tuple[torch.Tensor,torch.Tensor] _to_mx_rceil( data_hp: torch.Tensor, max_abs: torch.Tensor, max_pos: float, )
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: test_fn(*args, **kwargs)
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.signature: (dY, X, per_channel_scale, per_channel_zero_point, axis, quant_min, quant_max)
